title: Canonical hypercover comparison cocone for Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Let X be qcqs, A a Grothendieck abelian category, F an A-valued small-etale sheaf, and q a natural number. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-hypercover-resolution] with the proved injective-row theorem [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-injective-hypercover-row] defines canonicalComparison U q to the right-derived terminal sections. It commutes with all refinements. Consequently it gives an actual cocone comparisonCocone A F q on the filtered homotopy-cohomology diagram constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-hypercover-model].

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 1: canonical maps from hypercover cohomology to derived sections

proof.text: Instantiate the resolution comparison with the proved injective-row quasi-isomorphism.
The resolution comparison refinement identity proves the canonical comparison refinement identity. Descend its component maps to the homotopy quotient; quotient induction proves cocone naturality.

proof_origin.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 1: canonical maps from hypercover cohomology to derived sections; generalization from abelian groups to Grothendieck abelian coefficients using the categorical constructions described in the proof. The cited Stacks result itself is for abelian sheaves.
